capabilities: Render .eml, .emlx, .mbox and .msg files in a sandboxed view
Block remote content and strip scripts from HTML emails
Convert an email into a Markdown note with properties
Show embed cards for email files
disambiguation: Not a mail client: it only opens email files already saved in the vault and makes no network requests of its own.
extras: Embed cards rely on an undocumented Obsidian API and can be turned off in settings; the plugin has no Node.js dependencies and works on mobile.
problem: Obsidian cannot open email files such as .eml or .msg, so messages stored in a vault show up as unreadable files.
summary: Viewer for .eml, .emlx, .mbox and .msg email files in the vault, with attachments, inline images and remote-content blocking.
